title: subagent: Research MBTA Franklin line stops

content:
Research the MBTA Franklin-Foxboro line (commuter rail in Boston). I need to know:
1. The full list of stops/stations on the Franklin-Foxboro line
2. Specifically, how many stops are between South Station and Windsor Gardens (not including either endpoint)
3. The order of stops from South Station heading outward

Search the web for this information. Report the exact list and count.
